commands.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED_MAIN=7a21f68c4b0fe36e013081d43e4b667e3a4a77e8; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PORT=18115; git fetch origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"; git checkout -B main origin/main; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state)" = device; PIDS=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof llama-server 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true); echo gate_b_cleanup_llama_pids_before=${PIDS:-none}; for p in $PIDS; do adb -s "$SERIAL" shell kill -9 "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done; adb -s "$SERIAL" forward --remove tcp:$PORT >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 5; AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof llama-server 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true); test -z "$AFTER"; echo gate_b_cleanup_llama_stopped=true; echo '--- memory after cleanup ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "grep -E '^(MemTotal|MemFree|MemAvailable|SwapTotal|SwapFree):' /proc/meminfo; cat /proc/pressure/memory 2>/dev/null || true"; BAT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys battery | sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*temperature: *//p' | head -1 | tr -d '\r' || true); echo gate_b_cleanup_battery_temp_tenths_c=${BAT:-unknown}; CALL_STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); echo gate_b_cleanup_call_state=${CALL_STATE:-unknown}; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo gate_b_qwen3_4b_stopped_for_device_stability=true
